description: This file defines the ConfigEntityMapper class in the Drupal config_translation module, responsible for mapping configuration entities, managing entity types, and providing route and label information for configuration translation.

classes.name: ConfigEntityMapper
classes.description: A class that maps configuration entities for translation purposes, managing entity types, labels, routes, and contextual links within Drupal's configuration translation module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ConfigEntityMapper with dependencies and sets the entity type.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the mapper with services from the container.

methods.name: populateFromRouteMatch
methods.description: Populates the mapper with an entity parameter from the current route match.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity instance and adds its configuration name.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the label of the entity combined with the plugin's title.

methods.name: getBaseRouteParameters
methods.description: Provides route parameters for entity routes.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the entity type ID if not already set.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the label of the entity type.

methods.name: getTypeLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the entity type (duplicate of getTypeName).

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Provides available operations, such as listing entities.

methods.name: getContextualLinkGroup
methods.description: Determines the contextual link group based on entity type.

methods.name: getOverviewRouteName
methods.description: Returns the route name for the entity's configuration translation overview.

methods.name: processRoute
methods.description: Adds entity upcasting info to the route options.
